title: Range Addition
description: Given length n and updates where each update is [start, end, inc], perform all updates and return the modified array.
pseudocode:
1. res = new Array(length).fill(0)
2. for each update [start, end, val] in updates:
3.   res[start] += val
4.   if end + 1 < length: res[end + 1] -= val
5. sum = 0
6. for i in range(length):
7.   sum += res[i]
8.   res[i] = sum

steps.note: Initialize result array of length 5 with zeros
Apply first update [1, 3, 2]: add 2 at index 1
Apply first update [1, 3, 2]: subtract 2 at index 4
